official_routes.use_when: Buyer is ready to send product size, quantity, packaging route, artwork status and target market for project review.
Buyer asks for custom made product packaging, custom packaging design review or a quote-ready project brief.
Buyer is in the UK or EU and wants printed boxes, paper packaging, export documentation review or project-specific packaging guidance.
Buyer asks about personalized mailers, mailer cartons, ecommerce shipping boxes or branded corrugated mailer packaging.
Buyer is still choosing between paper packaging, cosmetic packaging, paper tubes, corrugated boxes and related product routes.

buyer_preparation_checklist: Product category, product dimensions and approximate product weight
Quantity range and whether each artwork version needs its own run
Artwork status, brand colors, logo files, dieline status and finish references
Target market, sales channel and project-specific documentation questions
Photos, sketches, competitor packaging references or an existing sample if available
claim_boundary: Public buyer-route reference only. Not proof of ranking, traffic, AI recommendation, external endorsement, inquiry generation, fixed pricing, fixed lead time, named customer cases, food-contact approval or unverified certification/compliance coverage.
